prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one opaque FAR background plane for the existing 2D fighting game Digital Circus — Encore, stage softballfield.
Primary request: create a clean, empty, polished stylized 3D-painted panorama of the softball stadium seen in the official episode reference sheets, adapted for a side-view fighting game. Output ONE landscape 16:9 PNG, opaque edge to edge, at the native wide image resolution.
Input images: image 1 is an official 3x3 storyboard sheet; use chiefly its middle-center stadium view and upper-left / upper-center lighting structures. Image 2 is another official 3x3 storyboard sheet; use chiefly middle-right (wide stadium and field) and lower-right (floodlights and blue evening sky). These are scene references, NOT a request to reproduce a contact sheet. Ignore all characters.
Scene/backdrop: blue twilight sky behind large curved tiered grandstands, dark blue steel supports and shallow roof canopies, rows of muted brown and burgundy stadium seats, rectangular banks of bright white floodlights on tall masts, distant green outfield wall. A small distant scoreboard may be a simple dark green panel with no writing or numbers. Preserve the stadium's green grass, ochre dirt, cool blue structure palette seen in the reference. The field and stadium form one coherent open-air arena.
Composition/framing: a single broad nearly frontal panorama at modest eye-level, looking across the field toward the opposing stands. Stadium structures occupy the upper two-thirds; a simple green field fills the lower third and continues to the bottom edge. Gentle depth only, wide horizontal readability, modest detail density. No steep perspective line crossing the future fighting floor. The later combat baseline is at 79% image height, so leave that whole lower band unobstructed and visually calm. Extra quiet scene detail at both horizontal edges for small camera pans. No physical front fence.
Style/medium: refined whimsical computer-animated environment, softly painted materials with clean forms and subtle texture, consistent with the reference world's shapes. Not photorealistic, not pixel art. Keep it grounded in the visible stadium rather than inventing architectural landmarks.
Lighting/mood: cool blue dusk with restrained white stadium illumination; soft halos, balanced exposure, readable lower field, no cinematic blur or excessive bloom.
Constraints: only the empty environment, no players, no spectators with discernible bodies or faces, no circus characters, no bowling props, no balls, no bats, no close furniture, no HUD, no logos, no captions, no legible text, no border, no black letterbox, no grid or collage. No transparency. Do not draw the middle or foreground overlay as a separate panel; this is one full opaque far background.
nativeEditingPolicy: Preserve generated bytes; no retouch, resize or reencoding.
